description: Hardened Deployment with a NetworkPolicy -- should raise nothing
note: The base every positive case is built from, with nothing broken: pod and container securityContext, dropped capabilities, RuntimeDefault seccomp, read-only root, non-root high UID and GID, resource requests and limits, both probes, no service account token, a bare digest-pinned image, and a NetworkPolicy so CKV2_K8S_6 is satisfied. Raises nothing under Trivy 0.74.0 and checkov 3.3.16 as of 2026-09-20.
